source.text:
I've got a hacker-news automation which creates a short video every time a new post becomes viral.

wile.ai: Every automation ends in a reel. Now, you can create your own private feed.

I've been working into this for a while.

We are currently pre-launch but any feedback is welcome!

apple testflight: https://testflight.apple.com/join/hgNKEm76

demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=stXmZyrZ-Hk
